 Applied Materials is seeking a Senior Procurement Manager to support its Photonics Platform Business, which drives both organic and inorganic growth of the company’s waveguide technologies and broader augmented reality (AR) ecosystem initiatives. This strategic role focuses on sourcing, qualification, supplier development, and quality management for advanced optical materials, including precision glass and crystalline substrates.
 The Senior Procurement Manager will collaborate closely with global suppliers and cross‑functional teams across R&D, Product Engineering, and Operations. The ideal candidate has deep hands‑on experience with optical glass and crystalline materials, strong knowledge of upstream manufacturing processes, and a proven ability to build and manage a high‑performance supply base. This individual will lead supplier assessments, define category strategies, and implement quality frameworks that ensure supply chain scalability, reliability, and long‑term competitiveness for Applied Materials’ photonics portfolio. The role will also be accountable for achieving key procurement KPIs across cost, cash, and contract performance to support the company’s growth and profitability objectives.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1) Supplier Lifecycle Management & Performance 
 Conduct supplier assessments, audits, and qualifications for glass and crystalline materials to ensure compliance with Applied Materials standards and regulatory requirements.
 Develop, manage, and utilize supplier scorecards and performance metrics, driving corrective actions and continuous improvement.
 Lead structured Business Reviews and executive-level engagement to strengthen relationships, track performance, and ensure roadmap alignment.
 Institutionalize standardized supplier governance frameworks, including supplier segmentation, financial health reviews and performance management for alliance and strategic suppliers.
 2) Quality Engineering, Compliance & Continuous Improvement 
 Develop and support APQP, PPAP, SPC, control plans, and material-specific quality systems for waveguide and AR-related components.
 Drive root cause analysis and CAPA/SCAR resolution using 8D, and FMEA, ensuring containment and systemic prevention.
 Partner with R&D and Manufacturing teams to improve material yields, durability, metrology consistency, and upstream manufacturing capability.
 Support implementation of supplier quality maturity models that scale with NPI and high-volume manufacturing requirements.
 3) Strategic Sourcing, Category Leadership & Commercial Management 
 Establish and lead a Specialized Procurement & Supplier Strategy function, enabling the business to achieve top‑quartile cost performance, cash optimization, and operational expense control.
 Develop and execute category strategies for optical glass, crystalline substrates, coatings, and enabling materials, embedding these strategies into the NPI lifecycle to accelerate speed‑to‑market.
 Lead sourcing events (RFx), supplier selection, and TCO analysis, including should‑cost modeling and competitive benchmarking.
 Deliver procurement KPIs across cost, cash, and contracts, including cost reduction, competitive pricing, payment term optimization, and contract compliance.
 Negotiate MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, and commercial frameworks that secure supply assurance, protect IP, and provide long‑term competitive advantage.
 4) Supplier Development, Innovation & Technology Enablement 
 Develop suppliers to meet scaling, capability, and technical maturity requirements through structured development plans and capability assessments.
 Foster supplier innovation, aligning emerging materials technologies (glass, crystalline, coatings, surface treatments) to Applied Materials’ waveguide and AR/VR product roadmaps.
 Support NPI by qualifying new and alternate suppliers, validating materials, and ensuring readiness from prototype → pilot → ramp → volume.
 5) Supply Chain Risk Management & AR Market Growth Support 
 Assess supply chain risks across quality, cost, delivery, capacity, and geopolitical exposure; implement mitigation plans and dual‑sourcing strategies.
 Lead supplier integration and quality due diligence activities for acquisitions, strategic partnerships, or emerging suppliers.
 Collaborate with R&D, Product Engineering, Sourcing, and Operations to align specifications, resolve escalations, and scale next‑generation photonics technologies in support of AR market growth.

As a Process Support Engineer (PSE), you'll play a critical role in guiding products through their entire lifecycle, from initial concept to final qualification. You will provide high-visibility customer support through on-site installations, system diagnoses, and the service and repair of complex systems and equipment. PSEs work closely with customers and R&D teams to develop leading-edge processes used to manufacture advanced semiconductor chips, and create hypothesis experiments and design of experiments (DOEs). You'll analyze data with statistics and compile reports with high-level conclusions on technically challenging process engineering experiments. Additionally, you will troubleshoot complex problems, perform root cause analyses, and resolve difficult process engineering and customer product issues. Process Support Engineers work across technologies such as: Chemical Vapor Deposition, Atomic Layer Deposition, Plasma Reactive Ion Etch, Physical Vapor Deposition, Anneal and Implant.  
 Role Responsibilities:  
 Provide high-visibility customer support through on-site installations, system diagnoses, and the service and repair of complex systems and equipment 
 Work closely with the customer to develop leading-edge processes used to manufacture the most advanced semiconductor chips, many of which are inside everyday electronic devices 
 Create hypothesis experiments and design of experiments (DOE); analyze data with statistics; and compile reports with high-level conclusions on technically challenging process engineering experiments 
 Troubleshoot complex problems; perform multiple root cause analysis; and resolve a variety of difficult process engineering and customer product issues  
 Communicate with both internal stakeholders and the customer to achieve goals with a focus on building relationships and establishing trust 
 Apply your growing knowledge of best practices to offer a new perspective using existing solutions  
 Serve as a resource for junior colleagues and a liaison between the customer and business unit; you may also lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements

 Bachelor’s degree in chemistry/ physics, materials engineering, electrical engineering, optoelectronics or related field 
 4–7 years of experience in the semiconductor fab or equipment industry  
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills to explain sensitive information and work to build consensus among project stakeholders 
 Communication proficiency in English language
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Master’s degree in a related field  
 Master's degree or above in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Semiconductor Engineering, or related fields.
 Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in ALD process development, optimization, or manufacturing support. 
 Strong understanding of thin film deposition fundamentals and ALD reaction mechanisms.
 Experience with process characterization tools such as XRR, Ellipsometry, SEM, TEM, XPS, FTIR, or related metrology techniques.
 Experience in DOE, SPC, and statistical data analysis.
 Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills.
 Good communication and teamwork abilities.
 Ability to travel domestically as required.

Responsible for clinical and scientific validity of study report, especially conclusions regarding efficacy and safety. Responsible for disclosure of appropriate safety and efficacy data and conclusions. Ensures narrative strategy for clinical trial(s) is consistent with program narrative strategy; writes (or oversees writingof) safety narratives. Assists in ensuring regulatory compliance for clinical trials and reporting. Contributes to primary publication of clinical trial results. May act as primary contact with external investigators and internal study team for questions relating to the clinical/medical aspects of the protocol. Responsible for keeping the Development China Clinical Program Lead and/or Development China Category Development Lead informed of any critical issues relating to benefit:risk evaluation, or study delivery in line with agreed budget, timelines and quality. Presents to internal and external advisory committees (e.g. Technical Review Committee, advisory boards) on design of clinical trials and data from clinical trials. Site Liaison Responsibilities (if applicable) The China Clinician may have site liaison responsibilities: Serve as clinical site liaison to support trial conduct through virtual meetings or teleconferences (as appropriate) and essential face-to-face contact, working directly with site staff. Maintain the ‘Face of Pfizer’ at each site. Create and maintain positive relationships and enthusiasm. Understand the work environment and key relationships at clinical sites, use analytical and influencing skills to improve communications and collaboration between key stakeholders. Ensure site staff have thorough understanding of protocol requirements (technical and logistic), partner with site staff and study team members to overcome feasibility barriers and operational obstacles and ensure successful subject recruitment/enrollment/retention, protocol compliance and clinical trial quality. Conduct frank discussions and set clear expectations for site performance and monitor site performance through metrics.  Field Quality Engineer 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a Field Quality Engineer (FQE) to improve service quality, customer satisfaction, and equipment reliability across our installed base. This role serves as the link between field service teams, engineering, manufacturing, quality organizations, and customers to identify recurring issues, drive root-cause investigations, and implement sustainable corrective actions. Reporting into Global Field Quality and joining a growing global network of Field Quality Engineers, this is an opportunity for a confident, proactive professional who thrives engaging directly with quality organizations and customers — including close partnership with Customer Quality Engineers (CQEs) as key regional counterparts.

 Coach field team on root-cause investigations and corrective actions for escalations and recurring product/service issues.
 Partner with field service, engineering, manufacturing, customer quality, supplier quality, and business unit teams to resolve complex technical problems.
 Improve the quality and completeness of service documentation, lessons learned, and knowledge assets to enable effective troubleshooting and knowledge sharing.
 Develop and track quality metrics, dashboards, and action plans to drive continuous improvement.
 Drive lessons learned, best practices, and knowledge reuse across the organization.
 Drive field quality capability development by reinforcing quality training, coaching teams on problem-solving methodologies, and promoting consistent adoption of quality processes and best practices.
 Support product introductions, ramp readiness activities, and field reliability improvement initiatives.
 Promote quality culture, first-time-right behaviors, issue ownership, and continuous improvement within the field organization.
 We strongly encourage internal candidates — including current Quality Ambassadors, Customer Engineers, and Field Service Managers — to apply, as this role offers a natural next step for those with field quality experience and a passion for driving service excellence. 
 Qualifications 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent field experience.
 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or field service engineering (e.g., Customer Engineer, Field Service Manager), manufacturing, customer support, or a related technical role. Quality engineering and field service engineering experience are considered equally relevant.

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret technical data and identify trends.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

 Knowledge of quality management systems and continuous improvement methodologies.
 Experience with customer-facing technical support or escalation management.
 Familiarity with reliability engineering, failure analysis, and data-driven problem solving.
 ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, or other quality-related certifications.
 Success in This Role

 Improve equipment reliability and service quality.
 Reduce repeat failures and recurring customer issues.
 Increase first-time-right resolution rates.
 Improve response times and issue closure effectiveness.
 Strengthen collaboration between service, engineering, and quality organizations.
 Drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction and operational performance.

 Install, maintain, and upgrade customer equipment

 Coordinate and communicate directly with customers
 Fulfill additional duties, as assigned

 Advanced mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, and/or thermodynamics
 Strong knowledge of hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint   
 Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required.
 Able to meet all on-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID-19 protocols
